description: Compare parking at the Seatac (SEA) airport garage for a trip with a round-trip private ride to and from the airport, using the same numbers as seatac.co/parking: Port of Seattle drive-up rates (taxes included) against example sedan fares from seven Seattle-area starting points. Returns both totals, which is cheaper and by how much, and the trip length where the ride starts winning. Optional: pass address + pickup_datetime for a live fare (one rate-limited quote).

address.description: Optional exact pickup/drop-off address in the Seattle area for a live fare instead of the stored example fare, e.g. "1301 5th Ave, Seattle". Needs pickup_datetime. Uses one rate-limited live quote.

bags.description: Checked-size bags for the live fare (0-12, default 2).

days.description: Days the car would be parked (whole 24-hour days, 1-60).

from_area.description: Where the traveler drives from (default downtown-seattle).

passengers.description: Passengers for the live fare (1-12, default 2).

pickup_datetime.description: With address: the ride's pickup date and time, ISO 8601, Seattle local time when no offset, e.g. 2026-11-02T14:30.

name: compare_parking_vs_ride

breakeven_days.description: Trip length (days) from which the ride costs less than the garage.

title: Compare SEA parking vs a ride
